login.perk3: See sales, trips and customers every day

routes.label: Routes and prices

ob.s0Lead: It takes about 5 minutes: tell us about your company and bus park, then add your first route and prices. Passengers can start booking right after.
ob.invitedEmailHint: Your invitation was sent to this address, so it can’t be changed.
ob.howSignIn: How do you want to sign in?
ob.signedInAs: Signed in as {{email}}. You’re all set to continue.
ob.googleFor: Sign in with the Google account for {{email}}. Other Google accounts won’t work.
ob.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn’t available here right now. Please choose “Set a password” instead.
ob.s1Lead: This is what passengers see when they find your buses.
ob.aboutPh: Years on the road, comfort, safety, where you travel…
ob.coverHint: A wide photo of your buses (optional)
ob.contactPhoneHint: Passengers and Gabla call this number
ob.parkLead: Passengers use this to find where to board.

ob.s2Lead: A few quick questions so Gabla knows who it’s working with.
ob.howManyBuses: How many buses do you operate?

ob.s4Lead: Check everything looks right. You can change all of this later from your portal.

td.tapSeatHint: See who is sitting there, call them, or check them in.

td.completeBody: Use this once the bus has reached its destination.

ses.emptyHint: A session creates trips automatically, for example “Kampala → Mbarara at 07:00 every day”.
